summary: Calls the virtual method at vtable+0xA0 (entry 160) to query whether the video/geometry resource needs a reload. When the query returns 0 (no reload needed), reads the source rectangle stored at this[0xE8..0xF4] (this[58..61]), obtains the render surface via Accessor(), and copies that region to the display with RenderSurfaceFillCopy. Returns the reload-query result.

operations.description: Invoke virtual method at vtable+0xA0 (entry 160) on this to query whether the geometry/resource reload is needed; result held in v2.
If the reload-query result v2 is zero (reload not needed), proceed to copy the render surface region to the display.
Load the source rectangle from this[58..61]: X from this+0xE8, Y from this+0xEC, width from this+0xF0, height from this+0xF4.
Call Accessor() to obtain the render surface pointer used for the fill copy.
Call RenderSurfaceFillCopy(surface, x, y, width, height) to copy the selected render surface region to the display.
Return the reload-query result v2 (the reload-needed value, or the copy outcome byte after the guard branch).

unresolved: The identity and semantics of the vtable+0xA0 method (reload-needed query) are unknown.
Whether the copy is a blit to display or to a different destination surface is not established by the packet.
